events.title: The Gameplay Is More Than Just Romance! Re 2: I Rise Alone Set for November 13
events.summary: Re2: I Rise Alone, a real-person interactive film game developed by Popcorn Interactive and published by Yixiang Interactive Technology, will make its global debut on Steam on November 13! This is the second title from the core team behind Rebirth: Do I Still Have to Fall in Love?, and the team spent nearly two years reworking the gameplay, introducing a great many innovative mechanics. events.title: "Rebirth 2: I Alone Counterattack" Demo Is Coming Soon!
events.summary: Foreword: To all our friends who support the game – Thank you so much for coming to try our demo. We are a small team, and there may inevitably be some bugs during gameplay. We appreciate your understanding. We also welcome any feedback – every word you say, even if it's criticism, is fuel for our progress. We've been working overtime and will refine and improve the content based on your feedback for the official release. We've been grinding on this for nearly two years, and we hope you enjoy it
